fire: The workshop mixes short talks and guided exercises with group discussion.
Apprentices learn the trade through watching and practice at the bench.
The summer camp offers nature walks, experiments and craft sessions for kids.
Our science fair lets pupils build models and present them to visitors.

Visitors can try hands-on activities and watch live demonstrations at the fort.

The library runs readings, craft tables and story sessions for families.
quiet: The workshop costs forty pounds and is held in a hall near the station.
Apprentices are paid weekly and get two weeks of leave each year.
The summer camp opens in July and closes at the end of August.
Our science fair was moved to the gym because of the rain.
The module is worth ten credits and ends with a written exam.
Visitors can park near the gate and buy tickets at the fort.
Nurses are paid overtime and work twelve-hour shifts on the wards.
The library is open late on Thursdays and closed on Sundays.
